structure.en: is what I'll likely be told

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そうだ added to a verb says it looks like the thing is going to happen. いわれそうだ = 'I'll probably be told'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The われ ending turns 'say' into 'be told': someone else says it to you. いわれ = 'be told'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と comes right after the words someone says, here the 'Fish again?' from the line before. と いわれそうだ = 'I'll probably be told that'.
